> Design record. Parts of this document describe components that were removed or replaced in version 1.3.0, such as the application controller class, the reducer, the time engine, the signals and error modules and the fixed protection efficiency. The source code is authoritative.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber

    User->>UI: Adjusts AQI (395), Selects Infant, Two-Wheeler

    UI->>CADR: evaluateCadrAdequacy(ach, 'residential')
    CADR-->>UI: CADR 273 CFM -> 10.1 ACH (High Protection)

    User->>UI: Clicks "Generate Clean Air Plan"
    UI->>KeyStore: hasKey()
    alt API Key Present in Volatile RAM
        UI->>GeminiSvc: generatePlan(context)
        GeminiSvc->>Circuit: canExecute()
        alt Circuit Breaker CLOSED
            GeminiSvc->>Google: POST /v1beta/models/{cascade}:generateContent (25s Timeout)
            alt HTTP 200 OK (JSON Schema Valid)
                Google-->>GeminiSvc: CleanAirActionPlan JSON
                GeminiSvc->>Circuit: recordSuccess()
                GeminiSvc-->>UI: { plan, strategy: 'GEMINI_LIVE' }
            else HTTP 503 / 429 or Timeout (>25s)
                GeminiSvc->>Circuit: recordFailure()
                GeminiSvc->>Offline: generatePlan(context)
                Offline-->>GeminiSvc: Deterministic Parity Plan
                GeminiSvc-->>UI: { plan, strategy: 'OFFLINE_FALLBACK', warning }
            end
        else Circuit Breaker OPEN (Cooldown Active)
            GeminiSvc->>Offline: generatePlan(context)
            Offline-->>GeminiSvc: Deterministic Parity Plan
            GeminiSvc-->>UI: { plan, strategy: 'OFFLINE_CIRCUIT_OPEN' }
        end
    else No API Key (Offline / Air-Gapped Mode)
        UI->>Offline: generatePlan(context)
        Offline-->>UI: { plan, strategy: 'OFFLINE_DETERMINISTIC' } (<15ms)
    end

    UI->>Impact: calculateAvoidedDose(395, baseDose, 273, vol, 2h)
    Impact-->>UI: Saved 583 ug PM2.5 (8.8 Cigarettes equivalent)
    UI->>UI: Reconcile DOM with Glassmorphic Animations
    UI-->>User: Displays Tailored Schedule, IAQ Hack Specs, & Impact Badges
